perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.desc: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.desc: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.desc: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

perks.name: Ancillary Ordinance
perks.desc: Rapid elemental final blows and final blows on targets affected by elemental debuffs periodically prepare a homing micro-missile, which is launched from your target after this weapon's next final blow. Multiple missiles can be prepared.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.desc: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Multikill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading grants increased damage based on the number of rapid final blows made beforehand.

perks.name: Kinetic Tremors
perks.desc: Sustained kinetic damage to a target emits a shockwave that damages any nearby targets.

perks.name: To the Pain
perks.desc:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage increases handling and aim assist until the weapon is stowed.

Taking more damage increases the effect.

perks.name: Outlaw
perks.desc: Precision kills greatly decrease reload time.

perks.name: Problem Solver
perks.desc:
Dealing sustained damage to Champion, miniboss, or boss combatants exhausts them and grants this weapon handling and reload speed.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.

perks.name: Vanguard Determination
perks.desc: After using your class ability, final blows with this weapon grant you bonus damage resistance.

notes: Inspired by @ImpetusAlways, @Saint_Kabr and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing bulkier minor adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content. Everburning Glitz is a precision frame scout rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic, and provides a ×0.8 horizontal recoil reduction so you can ignore the Recoil Direction stat. The stats are solid by comparison with its peers, and are helped further at Tier 4/5 when barrel and magazine perks are enhanced - see https://d2foundry.gg/w/2857870254 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. From the @Mossy-Max spreadsheet at https://www.destiny2.science/ base Magazine size is 15 (max 20). As we don't have to worry about recoil direction, on M+KB look for a boost to Handling from the barrel perk, or maybe a touch of extra Stability on Controller and then for the magazine perk, something to help with Reload Speed or a larger magazine. In higher level content or during sustained boss fights, in the first trait perk column, Shoot to Loot picks up remote ammo bricks or orbs from safety, and reloads all your weapons from reserves. There's also the option of Explosive Payload, which boosts bodyshot damage by ×1.15 and crit damage by ×1.094, inflicts AoE damage on enemies within 3m and inflicts increased stagger. To pair with one of those in the second column Kinetic Tremors emits three 6m AoE kinetic shockwaves after 5 crit hits (4 when enhanced) within 3s of each other, which are treated as weapon damage and inherit damage boosts so also proc weapon effects picking up ammo bricks and power orbs with Shoot to Loot. For the Origin Trait, there's Problem Solver, which is very good for PvE when facing yellow bars - 7 hits will apply Exhaust to an enemy, reducing damage output to ×0.75 for a 5s and grant +50 to Reload Speed and Handling for 10s (12s when enhanced) - both buffs are refreshable. There's also Vanguard Vindication to provide up to ×3 stacks of ×0.98/0.96/0.94 damage reduction for a refreshable 10s (12.5s when enhanced), on kills within 20s of using a class ability. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost mag size, weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
